mechanism: Fluoxetine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, which may increase mebendazole plasma concentrations; mebendazole is also hepatically metabolized and may compete for metabolism, though clinical significance is limited due to mebendazole's typically short course of therapy.
action: Monitor for increased mebendazole adverse effects (GI symptoms, dizziness); no dose adjustment typically required for short-term mebendazole use, but consider this interaction in prolonged therapy or high-dose regimens.
